title: Bi-parameter local linearization for the stochastic wave equation with rough noise
summary: We study a one-dimensional nonlinear stochastic wave equation driven by Gaussian noise that is white in time and rough in space. We prove a bi-parameter local linearization for mixed increments along the two characteristic directions. The proof combines characteristic cancellation with a localized fractional-energy estimate that controls boundary interactions caused by the rough spatial noise.
